name: Vans Electroengineerings
lm_rationale: Hem Securities Ltd. — 12 SME IPOs in 2026 (₹1,145.04 Cr), 10 positive listings (83%), 2 negative (17%), +30.34% avg listing-day gain (chittorgarh 2026 SME tracker).
net_proceeds: ₹25.00 Cr is for long-term working capital: ₹15.00 Cr in FY27 and ₹10.00 Cr in FY28, to fund projected receivables and inventory. The balance goes to general corporate purposes (capped at 15% of gross proceeds).
key_risks: Customer concentration and receivables are both high: the top customer was 42.66% of FY26 revenue (top five 65.74%), and trade receivables jumped from ₹0.39 Cr to ₹13.14 Cr in FY26 (108 debtor days).
market_moat: It makes RDSO-approved single- and double-pole vacuum circuit breakers and vacuum interrupters for railway traction substations and has CORE 'Approved Vendor' status for certain products. Products are tested at KERI (South Korea) and CPRI Bengaluru.
management: Promoters Hotspot Infodot Pvt.Ltd., Abhishek Saraff, Nitin Jain, Balakrishnan Srinivasan (plus Viraj Bansal and Pooja Bansal, who hold no shares); 90.75% pre-issue promoter and promoter group holding drops to 66.73% post-issue.
prose_business: Vans, incorporated in February 2022, manufactures vacuum circuit breakers, vacuum interrupters and other traction power supply and overhead-equipment components from Salem, Tamil Nadu. It sells mainly to Indian Railways and railway electrification contractors, plus metro and renewable-energy applications. FY26 revenue from operations was ₹22.84 Cr with 33 employees (Aug 2026).
highlight_dev: The order book stood at ₹50.62 Cr on 5 Sep 2026, as certified by the statutory auditor. That is 2.22x FY26 revenue from operations.
sector_outlook: The RHP's industry section notes a record ₹2,93,030 crore capital expenditure allocation to Indian Railways in the Union Budget 2026-27, including sanctioned works to upgrade electric traction systems.
peer_sentence: The RHP has no peer comparison. It says no listed company in India has a similar business line, so the 23.81x post-issue P/E cannot be benchmarked against a document peer set.
verdict_reason: strong growth and LM record, but 10.30x P/BV, a four-year history and a receivables jump
why: Total income rose from ₹2.76 Cr in FY24 to ₹23.19 Cr in FY26 and PAT from ₹0.02 Cr to ₹5.39 Cr, with D/E of 0.28. The company has only about four years of history and one customer supplied 42.66% of FY26 revenue. At ₹118 the issue is priced at 23.81x FY26 EPS on post-issue shares and 10.30x FY26 NAV. Promoters sold shares at ₹118, the upper band, on 19-22 Sep 2026. All of the specified proceeds go to working capital, which follows from receivables jumping to ₹13.14 Cr. Hem Securities' 2026 SME record (83% positive listings, +30.34% average) supports listing-day demand. The main risk is concentrated, slow-paying railway customers.
suggestion: Watch: listing prospects look better than average given the lead manager, but the rich P/BV and short history make it a small-allocation, high-risk bet.
documents: drhp-cache/vans-electroengineerings-rhp.pdf (RHP dated 23 Sep 2026, 320 pages; source chittorgarh.net rhp_vans_electroengineering_limited.pdf)
discrepancies: chittorgarh's PAT margin (23.61%) and EBITDA margin (31.63%) are the RHP KPI figures on revenue from operations. On total income, per the brief's formula, they are 23.25% (539.23/2,319.20) and 31.15% (722.52/2,319.20). Total-income basis is used on the card.
chittorgarh's post-issue P/E of 23.79 uses rounded EPS 4.96. The unrounded figure is 118 / (539.23 lakh / 1,08,80,000 = ₹4.956) = 23.81.

chittorgarh lists 6 promoters. The RHP cover also names 6, but the shareholding table (p81) shows only 4 promoters holding shares (75.75% pre / 55.70% post), plus promoter group at 15.00% / 11.03%. The 90.75% / 66.73% on the card is promoters plus group, matching chittorgarh.
The RHP leaves issue amounts as [●]. The ₹33.98 Cr figure is 28,80,000 shares × ₹118 and matches chittorgarh.
ROE of 83.27% is on average equity; RoNW of 58.79% is on closing net worth. Both are RHP figures and not an error.
Anchor bidding date is 28 Sep 2026 per the RHP cover. chittorgarh shows an 8,04,000-share anchor portion.
